set.body: Epic: bd-01KWVZJV5QB6JFPJ88RQHF2DBP. Extract the useful core from rMVPA feature_rsa_model as a real bidirectional feature model: fit a robust regularized linear map from feature patterns to neural patterns or neural patterns to feature patterns, cross-validate over FoldPlan, and report pattern/RDM/reconstruction metrics through the RoiAnalysis surface. Acceptance: one sound dependency-free estimator, typed direction ADT, deterministic tests for encode and decode, finite/shape validation, no heavy dependencies.
set.title: MVPA: Bidirectional feature encoding/decoding model
